### Summary

::: {.callout-note title="At a glance"}
Dispatch stubs connect an operation to CPU, CUDA and, where registered, MPS implementations.
CMake default OFF; layout DEVICE default cpu.
Order: code map; no independent measured convergence order.
No defining equation: this section maps control flow or data ownership.
:::

Dispatch stubs connect an operation to CPU, CUDA and, where registered, MPS implementations. The hydrostatic-reference
stub illustrates all three registrations. Tensor operations outside custom kernels follow the tensor device.

### Derivation

No separate derivation: this section describes an interface or control-flow path. Numerical operators are derived in
their owning chapters.

### Numerical method

The CPU reference kernel dispatches floating-point type and parallelizes over columns. Pointwise CUDA work uses
TensorIterator offsets in `gpu_kernel`. Line work uses `stencil_kernel`; reconstruction selects a tiled kernel when
the line exceeds the single-block threshold. The tile-width routine checks index range, stencil shape and
shared-memory capacity. Dispatch itself adds no truncation order; device agreement requires tests for each operator.

### Limits

::: {.callout-warning title="Limits"}
The shared DeviceTest parameter list has CPU and CUDA float32/float64 cases, but its MPS entry is commented out.
Registrations alone are not test evidence. No CUDA or MPS execution was performed for this chapter. The reconstruction
tiling test does not establish safe long-line execution for every other stencil user.
:::
